title: Frontend: UI constants, theme consolidation, and DI cleanup
description:
## Problem
- 131+ hardcoded color references across 25 files
- 463 hardcoded padding/spacing values with no design system
- 50+ hardcoded user-facing strings
- DI service_locator.dart has multi-level microtask nesting for circular dependency workarounds
- 143 TODO/FIXME markers

## Solution

### UI Constants
- NEW: lib/config/app_spacing.dart — xs(4), sm(8), md(16), lg(24), xl(32)
- NEW: lib/config/app_strings.dart — all user-facing strings (prep for i18n)
- Consolidate colors into existing theme (no new file needed, use ThemeData properly)
- Replace magic number padding/margins with AppSpacing constants

### DI Cleanup
- Simplify service_locator.dart: remove deferred wiring (Future.microtask nesting)
- Fix circular dependencies at the source (invert dependencies, use interfaces)
- Remove conditional registration for removed feature flags

### Code Hygiene
- Remove completed TODO/FIXME markers
- Remove debug print statements
- Remove unused imports

## Acceptance Criteria
- No hardcoded spacing values in screens (use AppSpacing)
- No hardcoded user-facing strings (use AppStrings)
- service_locator.dart has no Future.microtask nesting
- flutter analyze: 0 errors, fewer warnings than current 251
- Estimated LOC reduction: ~500 (net, after adding constant files)

title: Frontend: Remove dead code, unused dependencies, and outdated docs
description:

## Scope

### Files to Remove

- test_timestamp_debug.dart and similar test utilities
- Outdated .md files in repo root: FullRefactor.md, Maya.md, takeover.md, listenininganimation.md, ioS.md, playstore.md, DOCUMENTATION_STRUCTURE.md (keep README.md, CLAUDE.md)

### Code Cleanup
- Remove all Provider-specific code (ChangeNotifier mixins, MultiProvider wrappers)
- Replace any GetX usage (Get.find, Get.put) with GetIt

title: Frontend: Consolidate voice pipeline — remove legacy dual-path
description:
## Problem
The voice pipeline has TWO paths controlled by feature flags:
1. Legacy: AutoListeningCoordinator (1,994 LOC) + VoiceService (1,788 LOC) with callbacks
2. New: VoicePipelineController (Phase 6 refactor)

Both coexist with feature flags (voicePipelineControllerEnabled, voicePipelineControllerAuthoritative). This doubles complexity, creates maintenance burden, and makes reasoning about voice state impossible.

## Solution
Make VoicePipelineController the SINGLE path. Absorb the best patterns from AutoListeningCoordinator into it.

### Key Changes
1. Analyze VoicePipelineController — understand its state machine
2. Ensure it covers all AutoListeningCoordinator functionality:
   - VAD-based speech detection with RNNoise
   - Speech start/end transitions with debounce
   - Auto-recording on speech detection
   - TTS activity tracking (don't listen while AI speaks)
3. Remove AutoListeningCoordinator entirely
4. Remove legacy path from VoiceSessionBloc (dual stream subscriptions)
5. Remove feature flags: voicePipelineControllerEnabled, voicePipelineControllerAuthoritative
6. Simplify VoiceService — remove callback intermediary pattern
7. Replace callbacks with direct event streams

### Voice State Machine (single, explicit)
idle → listening → speechDetected → recording → processing → aiSpeaking → listening

## Files Changed
- DELETE: auto_listening_coordinator.dart (1,994 LOC)
- MODIFY: voice_session_bloc.dart — remove legacy path (~500 LOC reduction)
- MODIFY: voice_service.dart — remove callback hell (~400 LOC reduction)
- MODIFY: service_locator.dart — remove conditional registration
- MODIFY: feature_flags.dart — remove pipeline flags

## Acceptance Criteria
- Single voice pipeline implementation
- No feature flags for pipeline selection
- Voice state machine is explicit (enum, not booleans)
- VoiceSessionBloc has single subscription path
- Estimated LOC reduction: 2,500-3,000

title: Frontend: Simplify service layer — VoiceService, TTS, AudioPlayer, VAD
description:
## Problem
Voice service layer is 7K+ LOC across 4 files with:
- VoiceService (1,788 LOC): callback intermediary, polling instead of streams
- SimpleTTSService (2,032 LOC): queue management + WebSocket pooling + lazy config
- AudioPlayerManager (1,485 LOC): playback with manual state desync fixes
- EnhancedVADManager (1,134 LOC): complex lifecycle with 8 flags

## Solution

### VoiceService (~600 LOC)
- Remove callback intermediary pattern (canStartListeningCallback, etc.)
- Replace enableAutoModeWhenPlaybackCompletes() polling loop with stream-based waiting
- Remove delegation to AutoListeningCoordinator (deleted in bead 7)
- Remove Gemini Live support if unused, or extract to own service

### SimpleTTSService (~800 LOC)
- Keep core queue management and WebSocket pooling (good patterns)
- Extract WebSocket connection management to own class if needed
- Remove debug logging overhead
- Simplify resetTTSState guards

### AudioPlayerManager (~800 LOC)
- Remove forceStopState() hack — fix root cause of just_audio state desync
- Simplify token tracking (should be unnecessary with proper pipeline controller)
- Remove playback completion coordination duplicated from pipeline controller

### EnhancedVADManager (~600 LOC)
- Reduce from 8 lifecycle flags to 3 (initialized, listening, disposed)
- Non-blocking shutdown is correct pattern — keep it, simplify implementation
- Remove corruption diagnostic prints

## Acceptance Criteria
- VoiceService < 600 LOC, no callbacks, no polling
- SimpleTTSService < 800 LOC
- AudioPlayerManager < 800 LOC, no force-stop hack
- EnhancedVADManager < 600 LOC, max 3 lifecycle flags
- Estimated LOC reduction: 2,000+

title: Frontend: Extract business logic from screens into services
description:
## Problem
Multiple screens contain business logic that should be in services:
- ChatScreen (940 LOC): session end logic, mood logging, backend sync, wakelock management
- ProgressScreen (1,006 LOC): streak calculation, session aggregation, DB queries
- SplashScreen (733 LOC): complex initialization chain
- SessionSummaryScreen (545 LOC): task creation, anchor saving, backend sync

## Solution

### ChatScreen → ~400 LOC
- Move _endSession() logic to SessionLifecycleService
- Move _syncSessionSummaryRemote() to MemoryService
- Move wakelock management to WakelockService
- Screen becomes: render messages, forward events to bloc

### ProgressScreen → ~300 LOC
- Move _calculateStreaks() to ProgressService
- Move _loadRealSessionCount() to ProgressService
- Move mood aggregation queries to ProgressService
- Screen becomes: render charts and stats from service data

### SplashScreen → ~200 LOC
- Move initialization chain to AppInitializationService
- Screen becomes: show splash, wait for init, navigate

### SessionSummaryScreen → ~250 LOC
- Move task creation to TasksService (already exists, just wire it properly)
- Move anchor saving to MemoryService
- Screen becomes: display summary, forward actions to services

## Files Changed
- NEW: lib/services/session_lifecycle_service.dart (~150 LOC)
- NEW: lib/services/app_initialization_service.dart (~100 LOC)
- MODIFY: chat_screen.dart (940 → ~400)
- MODIFY: progress_screen.dart (1006 → ~300)
- MODIFY: splash_screen.dart (733 → ~200)
- MODIFY: session_summary_screen.dart (545 → ~250)
- MODIFY: services/progress_service.dart — add streak calculation

## Acceptance Criteria
- No screen > 500 LOC
- Screens contain ONLY: build(), event forwarding, navigation
- No direct DB queries in screens
- No direct API calls in screens
- Estimated LOC reduction: ~1,000

title: Backend: Refactor LLM manager with provider strategy pattern
description:
## Problem
llm_manager.py is 2,517 LOC with 7 providers × 3 operations copy-pasted. Adding a new provider requires editing one massive file in 5+ places.

## Solution
Apply strategy pattern:

### New Structure
app/services/llm/
  __init__.py
  manager.py (~300 LOC) — Router only, delegates to strategies
  base_provider.py (~80 LOC) — Abstract base with retry logic, error handling
  providers/
    openai_provider.py — OpenAI + Azure (shared API format)
    anthropic_provider.py — Claude
    google_provider.py — Gemini (including GeminiLiveSession)
    groq_provider.py — Groq
    xai_provider.py — Grok/xAI
    deepseek_provider.py — DeepSeek
  config.py — Move LLMConfig here from core/llm_config.py

### Key Design
- Each provider implements: generate(), stream(), tts(), transcribe()
- Base class handles: retry logic, error wrapping, timeout
- Manager routes by provider name, holds provider registry
- GeminiLiveSession stays with google_provider (it's provider-specific)

## Files Changed
- DELETE: app/services/llm_manager.py (2,517 LOC)
- DELETE: app/core/llm_config.py (422 LOC)
- NEW: app/services/llm/ directory with ~7 files (~1,200 LOC total)
- MODIFY: all files importing llm_manager — update imports

## Acceptance Criteria
- Adding a new LLM provider = 1 new file
- Each provider file < 300 LOC
- Manager file < 300 LOC
- All existing provider functionality preserved
- Estimated LOC reduction: ~1,700

title: Frontend: Decompose VoiceSessionBloc into domain managers
description:
## Problem
VoiceSessionBloc is 2,440 LOC god object handling 12+ domains: session lifecycle, audio playback, TTS, mode switching, auto-listening, message processing, timers, amplitude, recording, pipeline controller, Gemini Live, app lifecycle. 30+ event types, 42+ state fields, 22+ stream subscriptions.

## Solution
Extract domain-specific managers. Bloc becomes a thin facade.

### New Structure
lib/blocs/managers/
  session_lifecycle_manager.dart (~150 LOC) — start/end session, initialization
  audio_playback_manager.dart (~150 LOC) — play/stop audio, TTS completion waiting
  mode_transition_manager.dart (~200 LOC) — voice/chat switching, _prepareForVoiceMode
  message_processor.dart (~120 LOC) — audio processing, text message handling, response routing

### VoiceSessionBloc Becomes Facade (~600 LOC)
- Holds managers as dependencies
- Routes events to appropriate manager
- Aggregates state from managers
- Manages stream subscriptions (reduced from 22 to ~8)

### Event Consolidation (30 → ~18)
Remove aliases:
- SelectMood + MoodSelected → MoodSelected
- ProcessTextMessage + TextMessageSent → SendTextMessage
- SetInitializing, SetEndingSession, SetProcessing → internal state only

### State Consolidation (42 → ~25)
Remove duplicates:
- isAiSpeaking → derive from ttsStatus
- Remove pipelinePhase, pipelineMicMuted, pipelineAutoModeEnabled (duplicate of pipeline controller state)

## Dependencies
- Bead 7 (voice pipeline consolidation) — simplifies bloc's voice concerns

## Acceptance Criteria
- VoiceSessionBloc < 600 LOC
- Each manager < 200 LOC
- Events < 20 types
- State fields < 25
- Estimated LOC change: net ~200 reduction (decomposition, not deletion)

title: Backend: Consolidate JWT auth into single module
description:
## Problem
JWT verification (Firebase → RS256 → HS256 fallback) is implemented 3 separate times:
1. voice.py: JWTSecurityManager class (191 LOC)
2. llm_manager.py: inline in generate_response() 
3. app/core/auth.py: certificate caching and verification

This causes inconsistent auth behavior and makes security changes require 3+ file edits.

## Solution
Create a single auth module: app/core/auth_service.py
- Single verify_jwt() function with Firebase → RS256 → HS256 fallback
- Certificate caching with TTL
- FastAPI dependency (Depends(get_current_user))
- Remove JWTSecurityManager from voice.py
- Remove JWT logic from llm_manager.py
- Remove duplicate verification from endpoint handlers

## Files Changed
- NEW: app/core/auth_service.py (~120 LOC)
- MODIFY: app/api/endpoints/voice.py — remove JWTSecurityManager, use shared auth
- MODIFY: app/services/llm_manager.py — remove JWT verification
- MODIFY: app/api/endpoints/ai.py — use shared auth dependency
- MODIFY: app/api/endpoints/mood_entries.py, profile.py, anchors.py — use shared auth

## Acceptance Criteria
- Single source of truth for JWT verification
- All endpoints use the same auth dependency
- JWT verification change = 1 file edit
- Estimated LOC reduction: ~250

title: Backend: Decompose voice.py into focused modules
description:
## Problem
voice.py is 2,038 LOC containing: WebSocket auth, rate limiting, connection management, session management, 5+ WebSocket endpoints, TTS streaming, transcription — all in one file.

## Solution (after dead code removal leaves ~1,200 LOC)
Split into focused endpoint modules:

### New Structure
app/api/endpoints/voice/
  __init__.py — router aggregation
  streaming.py (~300 LOC) — websocket_streaming_tts endpoint (the main one)
  transcription.py (~100 LOC) — /transcribe, /synthesize endpoints
  health.py (~30 LOC) — /ping endpoint
  connection_manager.py (~150 LOC) — WebSocket connection tracking
  rate_limiter.py (~80 LOC) — TextInputRateLimiter (uses shared auth)

### Key Changes
- Remove disabled security code (lines 859-889 "TEMPORARILY ALLOW ALL CONNECTIONS")
- Remove JWTSecurityManager (replaced by bead 2's auth_service)
- Connection manager simplified: just tracks connections, no auth
- Rate limiter extracted to own file
- Main streaming handler broken into: connect, message_dispatch, tts_pipeline, cleanup

## Dependencies
- Bead 1 (dead code removal) — removes 4 legacy endpoints first
- Bead 2 (auth consolidation) — removes JWT from this file

## Acceptance Criteria
- No file > 300 LOC
- Single responsibility per file
- WebSocket streaming handler < 200 LOC (extract sub-handlers)
- All hardcoded values moved to config
- Estimated LOC reduction: ~500

title: Backend: Decompose streaming pipeline and clean up core
description:
## Problem
streaming_pipeline.py has a 2,100+ LOC EnhancedAsyncPipeline class that manages: queues, flow control, metrics, memory, client connections, interrupt handling, text processing. main.py has dual logging setup and bloated startup. container_warmup.py runs 8+ stages with silent failures.

## Solution

### Streaming Pipeline Decomposition
app/services/pipeline/
  __init__.py
  pipeline.py (~400 LOC) — Core pipeline: queue management, task lifecycle
  flow_control.py (~200 LOC) — FlowControlManager: backpressure, throttling
  metrics.py (~150 LOC) — PipelineMetrics + ProductionMetricsService
  audio_chunker.py (~100 LOC) — Audio chunk assembly and delivery
  text_chunker.py — Move SmartTextProcessor here from utils/

### main.py Cleanup (~550 → ~200 LOC)
- Remove dual logging setup (keep enhanced_logging only)
- Remove SimpleNamespace fallback settings (fail loudly instead)
- Remove Base.metadata.create_all() (Alembic handles this)
- Remove OpenAI SDK version check (unnecessary)
- Simplify lifespan handler

### Core Cleanup
- Simplify container_warmup.py: remove bare except blocks, add per-stage timeouts
- Remove unused core modules (connection_monitor if not integrated)
- Consolidate rate_limiter.py (one implementation)

## Acceptance Criteria
- No class > 400 LOC
- Pipeline file manages queues + task lifecycle only
- Flow control is independently testable
- main.py < 200 LOC
- Estimated LOC reduction: ~1,500
